review_candidates.title: Solution Architect (Digital Workplace)
review_candidates.job_function: Information Technology, Product Management, and Project Management
review_candidates.description: Overview This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-looking, high-performing organisation. We are seeking a Solution Architect to lead the design and evolution of enterprise workplace platforms, with Microsoft 365 at the core. This role sits at the intersection of business and technology, driving architectural standards, shaping solution strategy, and ensuring seamless collaboration capabilities across the organisation. You will play a key role in translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions, while influencing technical direction and adoption across multiple stakeholder groups. Responsibilities As the Solution Architect, you will define and deliver the architecture roadmap for workplace technologies, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise architecture principles. You will translate business requirements into practical solution designs, establish platform standards and governance frameworks, and provide technical leadership throughout project delivery. The role will also oversee the integration of collaboration platforms with existing enterprise systems, drive security and compliance considerations within solution designs, and evaluate emerging technologies that enhance digital workplace capabilities. Working across multiple stakeholder groups, you will guide architectural decisions, document technical standards, and support the successful deployment and continuous improvement of workplace and collaboration solutions. Requirements You hold a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with at least 8 years of hands-on engineering or solution architecture experience. You bring deep expertise across the Microsoft 365 platform, and a proven track record designing secure, scalable, and integrated enterprise workplace solutions. Strong technical knowledge across the following areas is essential: Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Endpoint Management Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Conditional Access Microsoft Defender and endpoint security Microsoft Purview and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Exchange Online and Outlook Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and collaboration technologies Power Platform, Copilot, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate Broader solution architecture experience beyond Microsoft 365, including enterprise integration and cross-platform solution design, will be highly regarded. Microsoft certifications (MS-102, MS-700) are desirable, while TOGAF, ITIL, or Agile certifications would be advantageous. To apply, please apply directly or submit your resume to Claudia at cd@kerryconsulting.com. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. review_candidates.title: Engineering Manager
review_candidates.description: The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world. We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs , your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe. You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix , and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime. Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem. About the role Gcore operates a global edge platform: a content delivery network, authoritative and recursive DNS, and the traffic management layer that decides where requests land. It carries production traffic for media, gaming and enterprise customers, and the difference between a good and a bad engineering decision is visible in latency and availability within minutes. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the teams that build and run the CDN control plane, the edge request path, the analytics and logging pipeline, and our traffic management services. This is a leadership role with real technical weight. You will not be writing production code day to day, but you will be expected to hold your own in an architecture discussion, question a proposed fix when the evidence is thin, and own the consequences when something breaks at 3am. What You Will Do Lead four engineering teams covering the control plane, the core edge and proxy layer, the analytics and logging platform, and DNS and traffic management. Own delivery on a two-week cadence: planning, commitments, and honest reporting on what shipped and what did not. Set and defend technical priorities with Product, Support and Maintenance. A large part of the job is deciding what the teams will not do this quarter. Own the incident and post-incident process for your area: severity calls, root-cause analysis, and making sure prevention work actually gets built rather than filed and forgotten. Run the on-call rotation for your teams and keep the escalation path clear. Develop your engineers and tech leads through regular one-to-ones, feedback and growth planning, and hire well when you have headcount. Improve how the department works: planning, prioritisation, quality standards, documentation, and service ownership. Ensure AI tools and approaches are being adopted. The kind of problems you will be closer to A sense of the work rather than an exhaustive list: Cache and shielding behaviour: how a large origin is protected, and how configuration changes propagate to the edge safely. Config delivery at scale: pushing configuration to a global fleet quickly, and knowing where its limits are. Analytics cost and performance: keeping a high-volume ClickHouse estate fast and affordable. Traffic steering and failover. Observability that catches customer impact before the customer does. What We are Looking For Four or more years leading software engineering teams, including experience managing tech leads. Production experience with internet infrastructure: CDN, DNS, reverse proxies, or large-scale distributed systems. Enough depth to reason independently about HTTP caching, nginx behaviour, TLS and SNI, and anycast routing. A track record of owning incident response and post-incident follow-through, not just attending the calls. Comfort running several teams at once, and the confidence to say no to a stakeholder with a clear reason. Experience with distributed teams spanning European and Asian working hours. Nice to Have C, Rust, Go, Python, at a level where you can review a change. Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse and distributed tracing. Kubernetes alongside bare-metal fleet operations. Experience at a CDN, DNS or cloud provider, or at a network operator. Experience acting as product owner for platform work. What We can be Straight with You About This is a mature platform with real customers and real legacy. Some services are owned by a single engineer, and reducing that dependency is part of the job. Product ownership for platform work is currently shared between engineering and product management, which means backlog quality depends partly on you. We would rather you knew that before joining than discovered it in month two. In return you get a genuinely interesting technical domain, a small enough organisation that your decisions are visible, and direct access to the people setting product direction. Benefits At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work: Competitive compensation Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year Private medical insurance for you and your family* Extra paid vacation and sick leave days* Support for life’s important moments and celebrations Language courses to help you connect and grow Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment* Team sports and social activities* *Benefits may vary depending on your location. Equal Opportunity Employer We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

review_candidates.title: Service Engineer
review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Senior Remote Expert Center (REC) Engineer specializing in Siemens PCS 7, you will provide advanced remote technical support to customers across the Pacific region. Your day will involve monitoring system health, troubleshooting complex control system issues, supporting lifecycle service activities, and collaborating with customers and internal experts to ensure reliable plant operations. You will act as a trusted advisor for PCS 7 customers, helping them maximize system availability, improve operational performance, and address technical challenges through proactive and reactive support services. How You'll Make An Impact Act as a key point of contact for the Hotline service, offering expert-level guidance to clients on Omnivise T3000 and PCS 7 systems. Provide expert remote and on-site technical support for Siemens PCS 7 DCS, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, and network issues within agreed service levels. Analyze system alarms, diagnostics, and performance data to identify potential issues early and recommend preventive actions that support system reliability and cybersecurity. Support lifecycle activities such as upgrades, migrations, patch management, backups, and health checks, along with root cause analysis for recurring issues. Build trusted relationships with customers through clear communication of technical findings and resolution plans, and contribute to service review meetings and continuous improvement efforts. Maintain accurate technical documentation and knowledge articles, contributing to knowledge-sharing and best-practice development within the Remote Expert Center. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation, Instrumentation, or equivalent, with 8–12 years of experience in Siemens PCS 7 engineering, support, commissioning, troubleshooting, or lifecycle management, ideally within process industries or power generation. Strong hands-on experience with Siemens PCS 7 Engineering and system administration, including expert-level knowledge of the Engineering Station (ES) and Operator Station (OS); PCS 7 or equivalent Siemens automation certifications would be an advantage. Working knowledge of SIMATIC S7 PLC platforms and Industrial Ethernet/communication architectures, with a CCNA or equivalent industrial networking certification considered a plus. Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex PCS 7 issues in critical plant environments, including lifecycle activities such as upgrades, migrations, patch management, and root cause analysis. Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and support customers remotely in a 24/7 service environment when required; knowledge of Siemens Omnivise T3000 and an ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be an added advantage. A strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to stay composed under pressure, collaborate across global support teams, and maintain a continuous learning approach to technical excellence. About The Team Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Outstanding opportunity for personal development working in an organization covering multiple facets of the energy industry and energy transition. Provide flexible and hybrid working arrangement! Work in a diverse team with an open approach that will constantly support you and your development! https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

review_candidates.description: Role Overview We are looking for a seasoned Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer with over 8 years of experience to lead our infrastructure strategy and automation efforts. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of our cloud environments across Azure and GCP , ensuring our Node.js, Express, and React applications are highly available, scalable, and secure. You will serve as the subject matter expert for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and container orchestration. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure Management: Architect and manage robust, multi-cloud environments across Azure and GCP . Optimize for cost, performance, and reliability. CI/CD Leadership: Design and maintain end-to-end automated pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions . Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Use Terraform or Ansible to provision and manage immutable infrastructure. Containerization & Orchestration: Manage production-grade Docker containers and Kubernetes (AKS/GKE) clusters, ensuring seamless deployments and auto-scaling. Security & DevSecOps: Integrate security best practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and automated compliance checks. Code Quality: Implement and manage SonarQube for code coverage, static analysis, and quality gates to maintain high standards for our Node.js and React codebases. Database Operations: Collaborate with developers to run and automate MySQL database scripts, migrations, and performance tuning. Monitoring & Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or cloud-native tools) to proactively identify and troubleshoot system bottlenecks. Technical Qualifications Experience: At least 8 years of professional experience in DevOps and Cloud Engineering roles. Cloud Platforms: Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . CI/CD & Version Control: Mastery of Git and experience with enterprise-grade CI/CD tools ( Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions ). Programming & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Python , Bash , or Ruby for automation and custom tooling. Application Stack: Familiarity with deploying and scaling Node.js (Express) backends and React.js frontends. Databases: Hands-on experience with MySQL , including the ability to execute and manage database scripts. IaC Tools: Deep expertise in Terraform (preferred) or Ansible. Quality Tools: Proven experience implementing SonarQube and automated testing frameworks. Soft Skills Troubleshooting: Exceptional root-cause analysis skills for complex distributed systems. Collaboration: Ability to work closely with full-stack developers to streamline the "code-to-cloud" journey. Mentorship: Ability to guide junior engineers and champion DevOps culture across the organization. If you take pride in delivering a smooth and professional customer experience through email, we would be happy to hear from you. Send your resume to: swathi.a@zapsgroup.com
